bounded.description: --min-sized-ints derives the width from the declared bounds, which is strictly more information than the format hint, so it wins over `format: int64` here.

unbounded.description: With no bounds to derive from, --min-sized-ints already widens to int64, so the format changes nothing.

boundedWithDefault.description: Same for a width derived from bounds rather than from `format`, which is the pre-existing --min-sized-ints path.
